project.description: Build the PSAMA image (hms-dbmi/psama) from the PIC-SURE Maven Build reactor workspace. Build/tag only; deploy happens exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE. Job name kept for pipeline/history compatibility; the repo jenkinsfile it once ran is deleted.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" AUTH_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-auth-microapp"
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$AUTH_DIR"/pic-sure-auth-services/target/pic-sure-auth-services-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt"
docker build -f "$AUTH_DIR/pic-sure-auth-services/Dockerfile" \ --build-arg http_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg https_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg no_proxy="$no_proxy" \ --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg NO_PROXY="$no_proxy" \ -t "hms-dbmi/psama:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" "$AUTH_DIR" docker tag "hms-dbmi/psama:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/psama:LATEST
